headline: A 2022 law lets federal airport grant funds cover bonus payments that reward contractors for finishing federally funded airport projects early.
what_it_does: The law makes incentive payments for finishing certain federally financed airport development projects early count as an allowable project cost. This means grant money can be used to pay those bonuses. The official summary does not describe payment amounts, eligible projects, or limits in detail.

who_it_affects.group: Airport sponsors that receive federal airport development grants
who_it_affects.how: They may be able to use federal project funds to pay incentives for early completion of eligible airport construction work.

who_it_affects.group: Contractors that build federally financed airport projects
who_it_affects.how: They may be eligible for incentive payments when they finish eligible airport work ahead of schedule.

when_it_takes_effect: The law became effective when it was enacted on October 10, 2022.
